answer.rationale: Promotional pricing (exp_73) demonstrated -12% 30-day retention despite strong acquisition—unsustainable given primary objective of long-term qualified revenue. Competitor's price cut triggers churn in price-sensitive segments, but matching discounts compounds retention risk. Instead, pivot to enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44): demo-request/sales-assisted flows convert enterprise better and build relationship lock-in. Simultaneously, activate referral_incentives (memory_57) with established customers to add qualified revenue without retention harm while price-sensitive SMB base stabilizes. Maintain in-product activation_messaging (memory_91) as baseline. Avoid onboarding simplification (memory_86) in this context—it may inadvertently accelerate churn in SMB under price pressure. Standard_experiment allows rapid signal on enterprise uplift while preserving ability to scale or pivot based on week-one results. This approach targets defensible, higher-LTV segments rather than competing on price.
